subject: SIG evidence request: deploy-gate logs, code-review sampling, and secrets rotation
messages:
From: Sierra Patel <sierra.patel@clearbank.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: sig-portal@assessor.co
Date: 2025-11-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SIG assessment

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG assessment we need a focused SDLC evidence bundle covering:
- PR/code review process and sample artifacts (who reviews, approval patterns)
- CI/CD gating logs showing merge/deploy approvals for the last 90 days
- Secrets management summary (ephemeral secrets, vault rotation cadence, KMS usage)
- Change management: how emergency/hotfix deploys are tracked and approved

Can you supply a package (PDF manifest + supporting artifacts) and a brief mapping to the SIG question IDs? Ideally we need this by COB Monday our time (Nov 10). We may ask follow-ups.

Attachments requested: manifest, code sample CSV, CI gating logfile, secrets rotation summary. Please redact any keys.

Best,
Sierra
Sierra Patel
Security Manager, ClearBank
Sierra.patel@clearbank.com

Thanks Sierra — looping in Kar (CI/CD + release gates) and Marissa (security evidence owner).

Karthik / Marissa: can you assemble an evidence bundle that covers the bullets below and confirm redaction steps? Key asks from ClearBank: 90-day CI gating logs, a 50-entry sample of PR reviews (CSV) showing reviewer, approvals, and whether CI checks passed, secrets rotation cadence (policy + proof of runs), and a defined emergency deploy workflow with one example runbook.

Please:
- Create a short manifest PDF that maps each artifact to SIG question IDs (store in Drive link).
- Mark any artifacts that require redaction and confirm who will do it.
- If we need an exception window for a hotfix (ClearBank may request), propose a controlled hotfix flow and an audit trail example.

Deadline: internal draft by Friday EOD (Nov 7 PST) and final bundle by Nov 10. If timeline looks tight, flag immediately.

Thanks — Lauren

Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Sierra Patel <sierra.patel@clearbank.com>, sig-portal@assessor.co
Date: 2025-11-07T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SIG assessment

Lauren — initial package attached. High-level notes below and artifacts attached in Drive (link in manifest).

Summary notes (quick):
- PR flow: mandatory code owner or peer review + CI pass enforced by branch protection. We include a 50-row CSV sample (code-review-sample-2025.csv) with PR id, author, reviewer, approvals, and CI status. Identifiers are hashed where required.
- CI/CD gating: artifacts pulled from our deployment audit (ci_gating_log_2025-11-06.pdf) showing approvals, pipeline run IDs, and artifact hashes. Gating includes automated security scans (SAST) and a manual approval step for production deploys.
- Secrets: we use transient secrets for CI runners via ephemeral tokens issued by HashiCorp Vault; rotation cadence for service-level keys is 90 days, with automatic rotation for ephemeral tokens (per-run). Summary doc attached (secrets-rotation-summary-2025.md). KMS (AWS KMS) used for long-term key encryption; access logged.
- Emergency deploys: documented hotfix flow requires one on-call owner + one senior engineer approval (two-person acknowledgement recorded in Jira ticket and deployment log). We include an anonymized hotfix example run (hotfix-deploy-1123-audit.txt) showing timeline and approvals.

Redaction: PII and credentials removed; we replaced PR titles with sanitized descriptors. If cert timestamps need more context for ClearBank, we can append.

Will produce a PDF manifest mapping artifacts -> SIG question IDs and upload final bundle by Nov 10.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

(Attachments referenced: code-review-sample-2025.csv; ci_gating_log_2025-11-06.pdf; secrets-rotation-summary-2025.md; hotfix-deploy-1123-audit.txt)

From: Tim O'Rourke <tim.orourke@clearbank.com>

Date: 2025-11-09T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SIG assessment

Hi team — quick clarifications from ClearBank audit:
1) For secrets rotation, can you confirm the service key rotation policy (90 days) is enforced via automation and show the last two rotation events (date + actor)?
2) For emergency/hotfix deploys, we typically require two approvers AND a post-deploy RCA within 48 hours. Your hotfix example looks good but can you confirm the RCA was filed and provide the Jira link or exported record?

Also, we have a time-constrained request: we may need a short exception to approve a high-priority bugfix on Nov 12. If possible, provide the controlled hotfix process and a suggested audit trail template we can use to accept the exception.

Thanks — Tim
Tim O'Rourke
Senior Security Engineer, ClearBank

(Attachment stub: cb_followup_questions_9842.txt)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Sierra Patel <sierra.patel@clearbank.com>, Tim O'Rourke <tim.orourke@clearbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sig-portal@assessor.co
Date: 2025-11-10T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SDLC controls for SIG assessment

Thanks Tim — quick answers and next steps.

1) Secrets rotation: confirmed. We automated service key rotation via our Vault operator; last two rotation events: 2025-10-07T02:14:00Z (rotation cycle), 2025-07-09T02:12:00Z. Auditor-facing proofs are in the manifest (sdlc_evidence_manifest_20251107.pdf) with redacted operator IDs.

2) Emergency hotfixes: our controlled exception requires (a) on-call owner + senior eng approval before deploy, (b) a post-deploy RCA in Jira within 48 hours, and (c) a follow-up remediation ticket if produced. The example included (hotfix-deploy-1123-audit.txt) references Jira ticket RB-4127 (export attached; we sanitized user emails).

Exception path for Nov 12: we can support a one-off accelerated approval if ClearBank provides explicit exception acceptance via the SIG portal. Suggested audit trail template attached as 'hotfix-audit-template.md' — includes timestamps, approvers, CI run IDs, rollback plan, and post-deploy checklist.

Final: I uploaded the final bundle to Drive and attached a zip here for convenience. Let us know if you want us to push a DocuSign attestation for the manifest.

Deliverables attached: sdlc_evidence_manifest_20251107.pdf, ci_gating_log_2025-11-06.pdf, code-review-sample-2025.csv, secrets-rotation-summary-2025.md, hotfix-deploy-1123-audit.txt, hotfix-audit-template.md, sdlc_evidence_bundle_20251110.zip

Thanks and happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

— Lauren
